segments.title: Cold Open: Pepito Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the top-of-hour broadcast sign-on as executive producer, identifying as the dog who produces the show.

segments.title: Opening Monologue & Subscriber Thanks
segments.notes: Case Blackwell opens the broadcast, acknowledges new haircut and shirts, reads early subscriptions and bits while bantering with Pepito about countries and national identity.

segments.title: Hype Train Derailment: JD Vance Dolphin Post
segments.notes: Hype Train commandeers the feed with freestyle raps over dolphin beats while covering JD Vance's ridiculed social media post featuring dolphin sexual content; includes subscriber shoutouts.

segments.title: Dolphin Interview on JD Vance
segments.notes: Case interviews a dolphin character (trad dolphin wife) who criticizes JD Vance for lacking dolphin family values and alpha dolphin machismo; dolphin promotes $13.99 TikTok course.

segments.title: Twitch Reported as Zombie Brand
segments.notes: Case and Tyler discuss Wall Street Journal report that Twitch remains unprofitable after 10 years under Amazon, faces potential layoffs, declining web traffic and ad revenue; Tyler jokes about being a Twitch subsidiary.

segments.title: Kick Platform Check-In
segments.notes: Tyler browses Kick live on air, notes top streamers including xQc and Adin Ross; Case expresses reluctance to support Kick due to ownership concerns.

segments.title: Munch & Crum: Avocado Toast vs. Grilled Cheese
segments.notes: Debate analysts Ralph Munchcut and Leonard Crum argue sandwich supremacy; Munch champions grilled cheese as the Zerg of sandwiches, Crum defends avocado toast texture symphony; grilled cheese wins 50-50 vote.

segments.title: Olympics Coverage with Rick
segments.notes: Rick joins for Paris Olympics coverage; discusses condom packaging, Phrygian cap mascot 'Frige' (red poop hat), French revolutionary heritage, and Tony Estanguet's liberty messaging.

segments.title: Chet Guy the Science Eyes: Shingles Vaccine & Hand Science
segments.notes: Chet interrupts via science trigger; covers shingles vaccine possibly delaying dementia, wildfire smoke as dementia risk factor, then tests sizehim.com hand-scanning site for 'perfect match' — pays $1, receives 'small big head pencil' penis classification, disputes results.

segments.title: Kendelle Phone Call
segments.notes: Case calls Kendelle mid-stream; she describes circuit training for TurboTax marketing, they exchange 'I love you' on air; chat hears everything.

segments.title: Opening Ceremony Highlights & French Banter
segments.notes: Case and Rick watch Gojira/Les Mis opening ceremony clips; Rick continues anti-French commentary, Case challenges whether one can be racist against the French.

segments.title: Jambalaya: Who Is the Secret Future Ghost of Rick?
segments.notes: Panel (Chet, Liliana, Grandma Crumble Bottom, Tyler) answers chat questions to deduce which panelist is secretly future ghost of Rick; Tyler revealed as the secret future ghost; CIA rebrand discussed.

segments.title: Semper Truth: Trump Ear Conspiracy
segments.notes: Guy Redacted analyzes AP photo of Trump's ear post-assassination attempt, disputes healing timeline, identifies anomalies (possible blade, UFO, multiple holes), defends Trump's jawline and blood lipstick.

segments.title: How To with Jeb: O.J. Simpson, Banana Shaving, Pop Locking, Diddy Drink
segments.notes: Jeb presents O.J. Simpson murder reenactment (misread as orange juice), banana shaving tutorial, face-pop-locking with 80s dance instructors, and a 'diddy' cocktail (vodka lemonade); Jeb's Dad co-hosts from wooden board.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored full broadcast; opened with new haircut and shirts; conducted dolphin interview, called Kendelle live, closed with Jeb studio origin story.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered cold open sign-on; bantered with Case on national identity and countries; issued no hospitality demands this episode.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: musical interruption. Derailed JD Vance dolphin story with freestyle raps over dolphin beats; acknowledged subscribers; declared immortality before fading.

characters.name: Tyler
characters.notes: Co-hosted Twitch zombie brand segment, browsed Kick live, debated sandwiches in Munch & Crum, participated in Jambalaya panel, revealed as secret future ghost of Rick.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argued for avocado toast in Munch & Crum; cited tax write-offs for grilled cheese and mountain climbing; lost 50-50 vote.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Championed grilled cheese as Zerg sandwich; howled wolf persona; won 50-50 vote; teased Case about second computer.

characters.name: Rick
characters.notes: correspondent. Joined for Olympics coverage and opening ceremony highlights; insulted French mascot; participated in Jambalaya as secret subject.

characters.name: Chet (Chet Manscape)
characters.notes: science correspondent. Triggered by 'science'; covered shingles vaccine/dementia, wildfire smoke risk; tested sizehim.com hand scanner, paid $1, disputed 'small big head pencil' result.

characters.name: Grandma Crumble Bottom
characters.notes: Jambalaya panelist; cited lawns as America's best; worst time travel reason: not having sex with LBJ; Werther's ectoplasm; Chrysler hood ornament lich headwear.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Received mid-stream phone call from Case; described TurboTax marketing circuit training; exchanged 'I love you' on air.

characters.name: Guy Redacted
characters.notes: conspiracy correspondent. Delivered Semper Truth segment on Trump ear conspiracy; analyzed AP photo anomalies; defended Trump's jawline and blood lipstick.

characters.name: Jeb Nogget
characters.notes: instructional host. Hosted How To with Jeb; presented O.J. Simpson murder reenactment, banana shaving, face pop-locking, diddy cocktail; co-hosted with Jeb's Dad.

characters.name: Jeb's Dad
characters.notes: co-host (spirit in board). Co-hosted How To from wooden board; bickered with Jeb; claimed to have met Rocket Ralph in astral plane.

lore_notes.fact: Case Blackwell got a haircut and bought new shirts before broadcast.
Case Blackwell is considering purchasing a second computer to offload graphics processing.
Chet spent $1 of network funds on sizehim.com hand-scanning site using a company card.
Chet's hand scan result classified his penis as 'small big head pencil' — he disputes the 'small' descriptor.
Kendelle is doing circuit training for TurboTax marketing campaigns.
Jeb Nogget helped Case Blackwell build the current studio setup years ago after overhearing him mumbling on the street.
Jeb's son Jet has been declared a hero in newspapers multiple times; predicted Diddy's human trafficking vibe in 2015.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covered JD Vance's viral dolphin post with a live dolphin interview and Hype Train musical derailment, then reported on Twitch's 'zombie brand' status per the Wall Street Journal. The broadcast featured a Munch & Crum sandwich debate, Olympics mascot ridicule, a Chet Guy the Science Eyes segment where Chet paid for a hand-scan penis analysis, a Jambalaya panel revealing Tyler as the secret future ghost of Rick, Guy Redacted's Trump ear conspiracy analysis, and a How To with Jeb finale involving an O.J. Simpson murder reenactment mistaken for orange juice instructions.
